scope: Native explicit personal memory read/save/forget through durable V2

contract.source: current authored text only; exact source span plus semantic durability admission
contract.forget: observed owned UUID, fresh whole-fact semantic scope verification, owner/content/category filtered delete

authorization.unknownWrite: quarantine for reconciliation; no automatic retry
authorization.ordinalReferences: frozen previous displayed snapshot; current lookup positions do not redefine user ordinals

context.auxiliaryTelemetry: semantic admission and embeddings reported separately from reasoning loop
context.forgetProjection: redact forgotten facts from old model-visible history; keep immutable audit evidence
context.presentation: certified cards; omit stale read rows after writes; do not certify whole-profile erasure

persistence.saveIdentity: sha256(category, exact content); sequential active-row reuse
persistence.embedding: optional configured provider, compatible 768-dimensional legacy memory space

productionReadOnlyVerification.explain: idx_memories_user_active index scan followed by bounded ordered result

limits: No semantic/paraphrase or cross-process save idempotence
Correction, canonical topic versioning and implicit clarification continuation remain pending
No automatic background learning or bulk/inactive-history erasure
Scripted provider tests certify protocol and fail-closed scope boundaries; live semantic quality is not measured
rollback: Revert the coupled memory work unit: contracts/tools, native memory store/admission/domain, core memory state/projection, composition, presenter, tests and documentation. Previous productivity/media/continuity blocks remain independent.
